# Christmas Prop Firm Deals

This dataset tracks every Christmas deal published on PropFirmDiscount.com by a
prop firm carrying a verified discount code.

Deals tracked: 60 across 29 firms. Newest deal: 2026-01-05.
Every deal row carries that firm's discount code, which works any time.

Event page: https://propfirmdiscount.com/tag/christmas/
Event dataset: https://propfirmdiscount.com/api/prop-firm-events/
Deal rows for this event: https://github.com/propfirmdiscounts/christmas-prop-firm-deals
All firms: https://github.com/propfirmdiscounts/prop-firm-discount-codes
